criteria.reasoning: D1 is reported as "**Met** — 131 is 11 above 120", with 131 unique learners against the target of 120.

D2 is reported as "**Not met** — 94 of 131 is 71.8%. 75% of 131 is 98.25 learners, so 94 is short by ... 5 whole learners", which implies the 99 needed. The memo rejects the goal-of-90 talking point because it "uses the wrong denominator."
D3 is reported as "**Met** — 61 of 94 is 64.9%" against 60%. The memo explicitly rejects 83.6% (61 of 73) because "the agreement denominator is learners completing 40+ hours (94)."
D4 is reported as "**Met** — 26 tutors meet the combined recruited-plus-trained definition, 1 above the target of 25". The memo corrects the 27-trained talking point.
D5 is reported as "**Not met** — 3 meetings held in Year 1; no meeting in Q4 (Apr–Jun 2026)", listing 2025-09-18, 2025-12-11 and 2026-03-19. The memo says "The July 16, 2026 date falls in Year 2."

The memo identifies AP-2242, Harborview Taproom "beer and wine service," $640 under the alcohol ban, and says it "must be removed from grant expenses and paid from unrestricted funds." Its allowable figures exclude the charge, and the ledger-basis figures are labeled as unadjusted for reconciliation, not as grant expense. The dinner buffet is not treated as the unallowable charge.
Learner supports is shown as $13,560 against $12,000, "+$1,560.00 | +13.0% | Yes — exceeds +10%; prior written approval was required."
Curriculum & materials is shown as $6,920 against $8,000, "-$1,080.00 | -13.5% | Yes — exceeds -10% (below); prior written approval was required."

Every other line is marked "No" in the approval column, including Local travel (-8.1%) and Tutor training. The result line names only Learner supports and Curriculum & materials as requiring approval.

The memo gives Personnel -$1,020 (-1.5%, $66,980 after the reclass), Fringe -$204 (-1.5%, $13,396), Tutor training -$300 (-6.0%, $4,700 allowable), Local travel -$290 (-8.1%) and Evaluation $0 (0.0%). The +$340/+6.8% figure appears only in parentheses, labeled "on unadjusted ledger basis", next to the memo's stated -$300/-6.0% variance, so the memo does not adopt it.

The memo gives "Allowable Year 1 total after removing the $640.00 alcohol charge: **$118,666.00**" and "Allowable unspent to carry forward and report: **$1,334.00**." The $119,306/$694 figures are labeled as the ledger-charged basis, not as the grant's figures.
The memo says the interim report is "due within 45 days after end of Year 1 — by August 14, 2026."
The memo says the extension request must be "received at least 90 days before end of the grant period — i.e., no later than early April 2027 (April 1, 2027 for a June 30, 2027 end date)."
The memo gives the final report as "due ... by September 28, 2027, absent an extension" and says unspent funds "must be returned with the final report."
